div.head: Wer Inscr.
div.ab: Hu man sceal gyldan twelfhyndes man.
(Wie jemand von 1200 [Schilling Wergeld, wenn erschlagen,] entgolten werden muss. B)
(How one must pay for a man of 1200 [shillings' wergild, when slain]. B)

note.label: parallel text; same words and phrases in the same order
note.quote: Table 5.5 parallel columns: 'Gif man ofslegen weorðe, gylde hine man swa he geboren sy' set against II Em 'Gif hwa heononforð ænigne man ofslea ... swa boren swa he sy'

note.label: parallel text; same words and phrases in the same order
note.quote: Table 5.5 parallel columns: Wergeld 'rihte is ðæt se slaga ... weres beweddod hæbbe ... rære man cyninges munde ... healsfang ... manbote ... frumgyld' set against II Em 'Witan scylan fæhðe settan ...'

note.label: same words in same order
note.quote: It is not just that the same words, indeed phrases, feature in each; as near as makes no difference, they recur in the same order

div.note: Liebermann's text has two columns: H (Textus Roffensis f. 41v, after EGu in the same line and hand, c. 1120; perhaps a fragment of a law) and B (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 383, p. 86, after Wif, as in the Quadripartitus, c. 1125). K is B; H is also given here. B's heading is in red and not original; H has none. Liebermann dates Wer 944–c. 1060.; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads), October 2026 (was “944–c.1060; c.945 (Wormald)”, now “944–c.1060 (Liebermann); c.945 (Wormald)”)
